site_id.description: Identifier of the site the unit is installed at

site_name.description: Name of the site the unit is installed at, at the time of the read

uid.description: The unit's own identifier, unique across the platform

online.description: Whether the unit is reporting: true once a reading batch is stored; false before the first one, after offline detection and while DEACTIVATED

last_reading_at.description: When the unit's latest reading batch was taken (its recorded_at); a batch delivered late never moves it back; null when the unit has not reported yet

last_known_temperature.description: Average temperature of the unit's latest reading batch, in Celsius; null when the unit has not reported yet

config_version.description: Version of the configuration the unit's edge gateway enforces; incremented whenever the threshold, the alert policy or the technician grants of the unit change

version.description: Concurrency version; grows on every change of name, type, reminder interval, threshold or status, not on telemetry. Send it back in If-Match to update the unit
